changes.summary: Adds pkg/automation/code, the Code node sandbox: a Compiler (esbuild, imports refused) and an Engine that runs JS/TS in a fresh QuickJS-ng wasm instance per run (github.com/iota-uz/kafig) under a wasm page cap and a context deadline, with Go-validated host calls, NewGuardedFetcher (SSRF policy), secret masking and Declarations for the editor's .d.ts. New dependencies: github.com/iota-uz/kafig/kafig-go, github.com/tetratelabs/wazero, github.com/evanw/esbuild, code.dny.dev/ssrf.

Add pkg/automation/catalog (registry of node types, trigger sources and connectors with a per-tenant catalog filtered by connections and author rights) and pkg/automation/connectors (AES-256-GCM connection store in the new automation schema with key rotation, platform credentials, usage, OAuth2 and a host.SecretResolver bridge), configured by AUTOMATION_CONNECTIONS_KEYS. graph.EventSpec and EventView gain an optional Description.
Add the @iota-uz/sdk/automation-editor subpath: the Solid automation graph editor over @xyflow/system with a lazy canvas chunk.

pkg/automation/graph: parallel, join, foreach and collect behaviors with tokens in the validator, interpreter and dry run (StepFork/StepEach/StepArrive, Interpreter.Join and ForeachDone, flow Limits, token-aware traces), with SDK conformance fixtures; expr gains TypeList.
Add pkg/automation/graph and pkg/automation/expr: the automation graph format, CEL expressions and templates, validator, pure step interpreter and dry run, with conformance fixtures.

Add modules/automations (Automations.* and Connections.Manage permissions, settings hub entry, connection store, OAuth2 and SecretResolver wiring, AUTOMATION_PLATFORM_CREDENTIALS) with the /settings/integrations Solid screen served from an embedded bundle, solid.Bind/solid.NewRPCHandler (a JSON-RPC server for Solid screen methods), connectors.OAuth2.Exchange (exchange and test a sign-in without saving), connectors.Store.SaveWith/Fingerprint/MatchesFingerprint, connectors.OAuth2Checker (refresh a disabled connection's token for a check), composition.Has, and connectors.Identity.Kind (handle, email, phone: only a typed identity is shown). Credential values are validated as the scalar type their schema declares. The extension runtime now uses a container-provided host.SecretResolver when wiring.Options.Secrets is unset.

Core, CRM and HRM publish 17 native events (user updated/blocked/unblocked/deleted/role_assigned, role created/permission_granted, group created/member_added/member_removed, client deleted, chat message_added, employee created/updated) to the outbox in the transaction of the change and list them in the notification settings catalog; modules.Natives includes hrm.Natives. composables.AfterCommit defers the services' eventbus events until the owning transaction commits: a caller that passes its own transaction to a service declares its owner with composables.OwnTx (or WithAfterCommit / WithSilentTx), otherwise the service returns composables.ErrNoCommitOwner. Event initiators are the acting request user only (job and system contexts have none), crm.client.updated.v1 names passport/pin edits and is not published for a no-op update, and chat, client and employee rows are locked before their change is measured.

The native event catalog, the outbox and its dispatcher (with pruning) become an always-on Go core composed by wiring.NewComponent, independent of EXTRUNTIME_ENABLED and of the @iota-uz/sdk Node distribution, so the outbox no longer grows without bound when the runtime is off (EXTRUNTIME_EVENTS_RETENTION, default 168h). Modules and applications register Go outbox consumers with wiring.ContributeConsumers (events.Consumer: receipt per event in the delivery transaction, per-consumer retries and dead-letter, run-as via events.ResolveSubject). With the runtime enabled the process runs one dispatcher and package subscriptions are its consumers (events.PackageConsumers). Adds composition.Contribute/Contributions and triggerowner.Assign. Direct callers of events.NewDispatcher: Config.Runner and Config.Subscriptions are replaced by Config.Consumers (events.PackageConsumers(subs, runner, subjects)).

Filter chips review fixes: flag (bool) chips open for editing — the chip names its value (Yes / No) and its editor switches it by click or keyboard; pagination.NewWithQuery keeps the list's query (search, chips, page size) in every page link, and the project stages list uses it so page 2 keeps its conditions. Lens: a date-range variable with Component lens.VariableComponentFilterChips renders as a chip of the shared solid-ui FilterBuilder (presets, custom range, required when the period cannot be empty) over the same URL parameters, so drill, export and links keep the period; the kit loads lazily. solid-ui FilterBuilder: date presets, required fields, editable flag chips, custom summary and labels. components/filters: Search and PageSize render the request's search, search field and page size, so a reload or a page link keeps them for the next filter change.

finance, warehouse, billing and projects publish 11 versioned native events (payments, expenses, debts, warehouse orders, billing transaction status, signed acceptance documents) in the transaction of the change; money travels as money.Wire; BillingTransaction.Read is a new permission; DebtService.Settle no longer fails after commit when the context has a user but no session; OrderService publishes the order aggregate events after commit.
Extension runtime schedules support a tenant scope, a missed-slot window recorded as skipped, and Go slot handlers served by the Go-only core scheduler (wiring.ContributeSchedules).

Human tasks are assigned to users, permissions, roles and groups and support a quorum with veto outcomes, delegation and escalation steps; adds Engine.DelegateTask and Engine.Tasks (inbox), workflow.TaskAudience with a core implementation, TaskObservers via wiring.ContributeTaskObservers, GET /tasks and POST /tasks/{id}/delegate, and a migration that backfills assignees and decisions of existing tasks.

Native events declare localized descriptions, a read permission, sensitive payload fields and a category under one snake_case key grammar; notifications.FromEvent builds notification definitions from them, and core.user.created.v1 notifications are delivered from the transactional outbox instead of the eventbus.

Run workflow contracts with a Go implementation (NativeContract) in the extruntime engine, which the Go-only core builds and serves without Node; host.New works without a pool, and Request gains InvocationID and Tx.
